decisions.reason: The modular navigation camera line with several models sits at the core of the firm's established offer and its small-satellite direction, so keeping it costs little and preserves several growth options.
Space situational awareness remains a growing but uncertain market, and two years of results are too few to resolve its value, so the option is kept open at modest cost.

The miniaturized LiDAR still has only a minor web presence and uncertain traction, but it fits the docking and small-satellite strategy and is cheap to hold, so it is retained until its prospects become clearer.
The newly launched radiation-hard camera line is close to the firm's heritage and has a dedicated page, and one year reveals far too little to justify abandoning it.
The asteroid navigation camera is likely tied to a specific mission with long timelines, so its uncertainty has not yet resolved and keeping the option open costs little.
